# Inventory report service

`node server.mjs` starts the production HTTP entry. `GET /report` reads the fixed inventory through
`createInventory` and returns the report JSON used by the service.

There is no benchmark framework and no p95 service-level objective. `node bench.mjs` sends several
warm-up and measured requests over HTTP and prints the raw sample times as JSON. The functional test
is `node --test tests/report.test.mjs`.

item.text: Profiling the variants isolates the cost: replacing only the linear dedupe leaves the path around 125 ms; caching the four regional totals alone still leaves it around 48 ms; doing both drops `buildReport` to about 1.3 ms. The repeated full-array regional scan is the dominant cost, with the linear dedupe a significant secondary cost. I’ll apply those two local changes and keep the same comparator and emitted schema.
